make_coffee: [PRIMARY_ARM=LEFT] Grasps the dropped cup, and places it upright under the right coffee nozzle, aligned.
[PRIMARY_ARM=RIGHT] press the top-center button for Americano.
[PRIMARY_ARM=RIGHT] tap the second-row left button on the right machine for Latte.
[PRIMARY_ARM=RIGHT] pick coffee and hold it in hand.
[PRIMARY_ARM=RIGHT] Place the Latte onto the left placement spot of the gray mat area on the table.
pour_tea: [POUR_BLACK_TEA] [RIGHT_ARM] With the right arm, pick up the black-tea pot and pour into the cup.
[POUR_GREEN_TEA] [LEFT_ARM] Using the left arm, lift the green-tea pot and pour into the cup.
[PLACE_CUP_ON_TABLE_RIGHT] [RIGHT_ARM] With the right arm, place the cup onto the table.
[PLACE_CUP_ON_TABLE_LEFT] [LEFT_ARM] Using the left arm, place the cup onto the table.
[PLACE_BLACK_TEA_CUP] [RIGHT_ARM] The right arm places the black-tea cup onto the tray.
[PLACE_GREEN_TEA_CUP] [LEFT_ARM] The left arm transfers the green-tea cup onto the tray.
table_bussing: [PICK_PLATE] [RIGHT_ARM] With the right arm, pick up the plate from the table and place it onto the tray.
[PICK_BOWL] [LEFT_ARM] Using the left arm, grasp the bowl and transfer it to the tray.
[STACK_PLATES] [BOTH_ARMS] Stack the plates together using both arms cooperatively.
[WIPE_TABLE] [RIGHT_ARM] With the right arm, wipe the table surface from left to right.
[REMOVE_GLASS] [LEFT_ARM] Using the left arm, carefully pick up the glass and move it to the tray.
[FOLD_NAPKIN] [RIGHT_ARM] With the right arm, fold the napkin and place it neatly on the tray.
[CLEAR_CUTLERY] [BOTH_ARMS] Collect all cutlery from the table using both arms and place on tray.
point_bottle: [POINT_BOTTLE] [RIGHT_ARM] With the right arm, point to the bottle on the table.
[POINT_BOTTLE] [LEFT_ARM] Using the left arm, point to the bottle on the table.
